# A .lgo parameter that leaks only into another parameter's pointee is
# recorded: it does not escape.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos build -gcflags=-m .
stderr 'p\.lgo:.*q does not escape'
! stderr 'leaking param: q'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/pointeelgo

go 1.27

-- m/p.lgo --
package p

type node struct {
	next *node
	v int
}

//go:noinline
func linkThrough(p, q *node) {
	p.next = q
}
